title: Beginner Guide
subtitle: START HERE
intro: This guide helps brand new players understand how to start SBO:R.
Follow these steps to avoid common beginner mistakes.

sections.title: Getting Started
paragraphs: Your first goal is to choose your weapon type. Each has it's advantages and disadvantages. But One-Hand is easiest to start with.
You can go from floor 1 to floor 2 as soon as you start. Most of what is on floor 1 is pretty useless till you start getting levels.

sections.title: First Steps
items: Choose a weapon type you enjoy
Do the Quests on floor 2! They help with getting quick XP and give you COL.
Join a guild so you can get help progressing.
It is a good idea to use the 2 defense 1 strength stat strategy. Maxing defense will help you so much no matter what.
